summary:
[  edit  ]
The XML  DAT  can be used to parse arbitrary XML and SGML/HTML formatted data. Once formatted, selected sections of the text can be output for further processing.
One approach to parsing with the XML  DAT  is to read the XML with a Text  DAT  or a Web  DAT , and pass that to a default XML  DAT . Then you start to refine your selection by changing the match-all pattern (the "*"), to strings that reduce the elements that are in the output.
XML and HTML Background
XML and HTML data consists of a tree like structure consisting of elements. Each element can be either tagged or contain arbitrary text. Elements may be nested. Tagged elements begin with an opening section and usually are terminated with a closing section.
Example:
<greeting a="1" b="2" c="3"> Hello there. </greeting>
In the example above are two elements. The first is a  tag  element named  greeting  with attributes  a, b  and  c . The second element is a  text  element consisting of " Hello there. "
XML  DAT  Operation
The XML  DAT  begins by parsing its input, creating an internal tree of elements.
The  Element  Scope   parameters are then used to filter out unwanted elements. The remaining elements are then used to create the output. The format of the output is determined by the  Format  parameters. The  Output  parameters can then be used to futher limit the information displayed for each scoped element.
Each parsed element contains a number of details:
Label  - Each element is given an arbitrary label named n0, n1, n2 etc. All elements are children of the reserved element labelled 'root'.
Type  - Elements are mainly of type 'tag' or 'text', though tag types can be further classified into 'doctype', 'declaration', 'comment' or 'entity'.
Text  - The text of an element refers to the tag attribute of an element, or the arbitrary text contents. In the above example, the first element would be of type 'tag' and contain text of 'greeting'. The second element would be of type 'text' and contain text of 'Hello there.'
Level  - This describes how deeply nested an element is. For example the single root element always has a level of 0.
Parent   - Each element contains one parent. The root element does not have a parent.
Children  - Each element can have an arbitrary number of children elements.

parameters.label: Parse SGML/HTML
parameters.name: sgml
parameters.description: If enabled, the input should be in SGML/HTML format. This includes form data. If disabled, XML format is assumed.

parameters.label: Merge
parameters.name: merge
parameters.description: ⊞  - Merge and label can be used to combine two inputs of data. The second input must be XML formatted, and not SGML/HTML. These two parameters control where and how the second input is merged.

parameters.label: Before Element
parameters.name: before
parameters.description: The second input is merged before the specified element label.

parameters.label: After Element
parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The second input is merged after the specified element label.

parameters.label: Inside Element
parameters.name: inside
parameters.description: The second input is merged as a child of the specified element label.

parameters.label: Replace Element
parameters.name: replace
parameters.description: The second input replaces the specified element label.

parameters.label: Label
parameters.name: mlabel
parameters.description: Specify the element at which the merge occurs.

parameters.label: Label
parameters.name: label
parameters.description: Element labels must match this parameter.

parameters.label: Type
parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Element types must match this parameter.

parameters.label: Text
parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Element text must match this parameter.

parameters.label: Name
parameters.name: name
parameters.description: If an element contains attributes, at least one must have a name matching this parameter.

parameters.label: Value
parameters.name: value
parameters.description: If an element contains attributes, at least one must have a value matching this parameter.

parameters.label: Parent Label
parameters.name: plabel
parameters.description: Elements must have a parent whose label matches this parameter.

parameters.label: Parent Type
parameters.name: ptype
parameters.description: Elements must have a parent whose type matches this parameter.

parameters.label: Parent Text
parameters.name: ptext
parameters.description: Elements must have a parent whose text matches this parameter.

parameters.label: Parent Name
parameters.name: pname
parameters.description: Elements must have a parent with an attribute whose name matches this parameter.

parameters.label: Parent Value
parameters.name: pvalue
parameters.description: Elements must have a parent with an attribute whose value matches this parameter.

parameters.label: Name  Attributes
parameters.name: oaname
parameters.description: Only output attributes whos name match this parameter.

parameters.label: Value  Attributes
parameters.name: oavalue
parameters.description: Only output attributes whose value match this parameter.

parameters.label: Children Labels
parameters.name: oclabel
parameters.description: Only output children whose label match this parameter.

parameters.label: Show
parameters.name: show
parameters.description: ⊞  - This controls how the selected elements are presented.

parameters.label: Summary Tree
parameters.name: sumtree
parameters.description: This output selection is similar to the summary table, except it outputs an indented ascii representation of the tree. It can be used to quickly identify areas of interest while picking appropriate parameters.

parameters.label: XML
parameters.name: xml
parameters.description: This outputs an XML compliant tree of the selected elements. It can then be fed into another XML  DAT  for further processing.

parameters.label: Attributes  per Row
parameters.name: attribs
parameters.description: This outputs a table of all attributes for the selected elements. Each element attribute is output on a separate row.

parameters.label: Attributes  per Column
parameters.name: attribscol
parameters.description: This outputs a table of all attributes for the selected elements. Each element is output in output on a single row, where each column represents one attribute.

parameters.label: Children
parameters.name: children
parameters.description: This outputs a table of all children for the selected elements.

parameters.label: Text
parameters.name: text
parameters.description: This outputs all text contents from all elements of type 'text'.

parameters.label: Label Prefix
parameters.name: lprefix
parameters.description: This determines whether or not the element label is prefixed when outputting tables or attributes or children.

parameters.label: Language
parameters.name: language
parameters.description: ⊞  - Select how the  DAT  decides which script language to operate on.

parameters.label: Input
parameters.name: input
parameters.description: The  DAT  uses the inputs script language.

parameters.label: Node
parameters.name: node
parameters.description: The  DAT  uses it's own script language.

parameters.label: Edit/View Extension
parameters.name: extension
parameters.description: ⊞  - Select the file extension this  DAT  should expose to external editors.

parameters.label: dat
parameters.name: dat
parameters.description: various common file extensions.

parameters.label: From Language
parameters.name: languageext
parameters.description: pick extension from DATs script language.

parameters.label: Custom Extension
parameters.name: customext
parameters.description: Specify a custom extension.

parameters.label: Custom Extension
parameters.name: customext
parameters.description: Specifiy the custom extension.

parameters.label: Word Wrap
parameters.name: wordwrap
parameters.description: ⊞  - Enable Word Wrap for Node Display.

parameters.label: Input
parameters.name: input
parameters.description: The  DAT  uses the inputs setting.

parameters.label: On
parameters.name: on
parameters.description: Turn on Word Wrap.

parameters.label: Off
parameters.name: off
parameters.description: Turn off Word Wrap.

parameters.label: num_rows
parameters.description: Number of rows in this  DAT .

parameters.label: num_cols
parameters.description: Number of columns in this  DAT .

parameters.label: total_cooks
parameters.description: Number of times the operator has cooked since the process started.

parameters.label: cook_time
parameters.description: Duration of the last cook in milliseconds.

parameters.label: cook_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the component timeline.

parameters.label: cook_abs_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the absolute time.

parameters.label: cook_start_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator started cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cook_end_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator finished cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cooked_this_frame
parameters.description: 1 if operator was cooked this frame.

parameters.label: warnings
parameters.description: Number of warnings in this operator if any.

parameters.label: errors
parameters.description: Number of errors in this operator if any.
